Name: Medieval Map Icons
Author: Lyi4a
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Description[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=3]Map Icons that match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek]Gweniaczek's[/url] '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url]', '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url]' and '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url]'. There are two versions, one for the vanilla maps and one compatible with '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]', so make sure you download the right version. Both folders include a buildings replacement for '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url]'.[/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][color=#900000][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [u]Required![/u][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][size=3]1. Pick the correct version and download. (SVE [color=#ffd966][u]OR[/u][/color][color=#ffffff] [/color]Vanilla, you can only have [color=#00ff00][u]ONE[/u][/color] version!)[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]2. Unzip/Extract[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]3. Drag the [CP] folder into your Stardew/Mods folder and you're done![/size][/center]
[center][size=3](If you use '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url]' mod, make sure to let it overwrite the 'NPCMapLocations' folder. If not, you can just delete that folder!)[/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded [/url][color=#6aa84f][size=4]✓[/size][/color][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] [color=#6aa84f][size=4]✓[/size][/color][/center]
